name: Scratch
english_description: A three-file FluffOS starter by the Lil author (rmanis), shipped with the line "If you consider Lil to have too much, start from Scratch." Not a game: no accounts, rooms, or combat. Connecting drops you into an echo chamber that prints unknown input as %O; look/score/quit are present. Not collection lil (the MudOS testsuite lib).
